title: A Survey of Tool-Using Language Models in Agentic Workflows
title_zh: 工具调用语言模型与 Agent 工作流综述
abstract: This survey reviews tool-using language models, agentic workflow design, evaluation protocols, and reliability challenges for multi-step reasoning systems.

title: Vision-Language Foundation Models for Clinical Imaging Evaluation
title_zh: 面向临床影像评估的视觉语言基础模型
abstract: The paper evaluates vision-language foundation models across radiology and pathology tasks, highlighting dataset shift, calibration, and clinical validation gaps.

title: Graph Representation Learning for Biomedical Knowledge Graph Reasoning
title_zh: 用于生物医学知识图谱推理的图表示学习
abstract: A graph neural network method improves biomedical relation prediction by combining graph contrastive pretraining with domain-aware negative sampling.

title: Claude Skills and the Emerging Agent Skill Packaging Pattern
title_zh: Claude Skills 与 Agent Skill 打包模式的兴起
abstract: The update shows how reusable skill packages can give agents domain-specific instructions, scripts, and assets for repeatable workflows.

title: Masked Multimodal Pretraining Improves Low-Label Medical AI
title_zh: 遮蔽式多模态预训练改善低标注医学 AI
abstract: Self-supervised masked modeling across reports and images improves low-label performance in medical classification and retrieval tasks.

title: Reward Model Calibration for Long-Horizon Language Agent Tasks
title_zh: 长程语言智能体任务中的奖励模型校准
abstract: The work studies reward model calibration for long-horizon agent tasks and reports failure cases in planning, tool use, and delayed feedback.

title: New Tools for Building Reliable AI Agents
title_zh: 构建可靠 AI Agent 的新工具
abstract: A product update introduces agent building blocks, evaluation hooks, and tool integration patterns for production AI systems.

title: Visual Reasoning Benchmarks Expose Shortcut Learning in Multimodal Models
title_zh: 视觉推理基准揭示多模态模型的捷径学习
abstract: A benchmark suite shows that multimodal models often rely on shortcut correlations rather than compositional visual reasoning.

title: Skill Middleware Patterns for LangGraph Agents
title_zh: LangGraph Agent 的 Skill 中间件模式
abstract: The article discusses packaging reusable agent skills, selecting tools dynamically, and evaluating workflow reliability in LangGraph applications.

title: Clinical Evaluation Protocols for Large Language Models in Hospitals
title_zh: 医院场景中大语言模型的临床评估协议
abstract: The paper proposes a clinical evaluation protocol for hospital LLM deployments, covering safety, workflow fit, and human oversight.

title: Scaling Graph Neural Networks with Self-Supervised Subgraph Objectives
title_zh: 用自监督子图目标扩展图神经网络
abstract: A self-supervised subgraph prediction objective improves graph neural network pretraining on large heterogeneous graphs.

title: ICLR Oral Papers Highlight Agent Evaluation and Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: ICLR Oral 论文强调 Agent 评估与多模态推理
abstract: Accepted oral papers show growing attention to agent evaluation, reliable tool use, multimodal reasoning, and representation learning.

title: Auditing Tool-Calling Failures in Enterprise AI Assistants
title_zh: 企业 AI 助手中的工具调用失败审计
abstract: The study audits tool-calling failures in enterprise assistants and categorizes errors in retrieval, permission handling, and multi-step execution.

title: A New Benchmark for Scientific Discovery Agents
title_zh: 面向科学发现 Agent 的新基准
abstract: A new benchmark evaluates agents on scientific discovery workflows that require literature search, hypothesis generation, and experiment planning.

title: Papers with Code Trending: Medical Multimodal Retrieval
title_zh: Papers with Code 趋势：医学多模态检索
abstract: Trending repositories focus on multimodal retrieval for medical images and reports, with several open benchmarks and reproducible baselines.
